headline: Presentation from Maine Immigrant Rights Coalition on ICE enforcement activities and update on PPS Family Emergency Preparedness Plan.
summary: The committee will hear insights from a recent Board Community Engagement Meeting with Multilingual Families, a presentation from the Maine Immigrant Rights Coalition (MIRC) on local ICE enforcement data and trends, and an update on the PPS Family Emergency Preparedness Plan.
items: Insights from recent Board Community Engagement Meeting with Multilingual Families

Presentation from Maine Immigrant Rights Coalition (MIRC) on current data and trends regarding local ICE enforcement activities, including apprehension and detention tactics and who is targeted, and community and mutual aid response
Update on the PPS Family Emergency Preparedness Plan
